commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+6' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot inside the right post, but Maarten Vandevoordt makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
90+2' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the right post!
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

89' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Alexander Nubel, who pulls off a stunning save!
88' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Ridle Baku is replaced by Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig).

86' A sweet pass inside the box gives Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
86' A substitution has been made. Atakan Karazor goes off and Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
83' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) receives a yellow card for infringement.
82' RB Leipzig can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
81' Problems for Sebastian Hoeness as Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Lorenz Assignon replaces him.
81' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from David Raum (RB Leipzig). RB Leipzig will take a corner kick.
78' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
77' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Stuttgart, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

69' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Ermedin Demirovic.

68' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
66' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

64' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ezechiel Banzuzi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig).
63' Stuttgart take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
59' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
56' 1 - 0 Goal Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart)! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) was put through by Chris Fuhrich and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
55' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
55' A quickly taken corner by Stuttgart.

54' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. Stuttgart will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

54' A cross from the free kick finds its way to Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) in front of goal and he steers a bullet header towards the bottom left corner. Alexander Nubel pulls off a fabulous save to deny him, parrying the ball onto the post.
53' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to RB Leipzig.

50' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
48' Neat passing move from RB Leipzig in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The whistle blows and Deniz Aytekin starts the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+2' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the left side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and the keeper pulls off an easy save.
45+2' Stuttgart restart play with a quick free kick.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' 59:41 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

39' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Deniz Aytekin had an easy-decision to make.
37' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.

34' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.

33' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
32' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) commits a foul and Deniz Aytekin immediately signals a free kick.
30' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.

28' The RB Leipzig players are exchanging some short passes.
26' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
23' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

21' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
21' Stuttgart have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
20' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
20' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Stuttgart.
19' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Stuttgart.
18' Stuttgart enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
16' David Raum (RB Leipzig) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

15' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
14' The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
11' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
9' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) picks up a long through ball, but Alexander Nubel deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
7' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
5' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
4' RB Leipzig are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
